{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS404 |prevtitle=Encountering Elekid |nextcode=PS406 |nexttitle=Halting Honchkrow |series=Diamond & Pearl |colorscheme=Sinnoh}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Shorting Out Electivire |subtitle=Strength and Experience |title_ja=VS エレキブル |title_ro=VS Elekible |image=PS405.png |scheme=Diamond & Pearl |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 405 in [[Pokémon Adventures volume 37|Vol. 37]] |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 68 in [[Pokémon Adventures volume 37|Vol. 8]] |location=[[Spring Path]] }} '''Shorting Out Electivire''' (Japanese: '''VS エレキブル''' ''VS Electivire''), titled '''VS Electivire''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 405th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 68th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Strength and Experience''' (Japanese: '''強さと体験''' ''Power and Experience'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Strength and Experience''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Candice]], [[Maylene]], and {{adv|Platinum}} arrive at [[Spring Path]], where they are supposed to meet [[Volkner]]. After they find Volkner, they tell him he is supposed to train them. Volkner is disappointing to hear that he is there to train, which isn't what he was told. Volkner then has his {{p|Raichu}} and {{p|Elekid}} use {{m|Discharge}} on Candice, Maylene, and Platinum, causing them to get injured. Valkner then turns to leave, but Candice asks him what he heard. Volkner says he was disappointed, because [[Byron]] said he would be meeting a dangerous enemy there. They then explain that the enemy is [[Jupiter]], a {{tc|Commander}} from [[Team Galactic]]. They then tell Volkner that Jupiter just beat all three of them. Platinum then introduces herself and challenges Volkner to a battle to show him Jupiter's battle style. First Platinum sends out {{TP|Platinum|Lopunny}} against Volkner's Elekid. Using its speed Lopunny mimics {{p|Sableye}}'s {{m|Shadow Sneak}} attack and defeats Elekid. She then sends out her {{TP|Platinum|Rapidash}} against Volkner's Raichu. Rapidash uses its powerful flames to show him how Jupiter used her {{p|Tangrowth}}'s vines to fight from a distance. Volkner, now impressed by Platinum's skills and interested in battling Jupiter, sends out his most powerful Pokémon, {{p|Electivire}}. Platinum counters with her powerhouse {{TP|Platinum|Empoleon}}. Empoleon uses {{m|Blizzard}} to show Volkner how Jupiter's {{p|Gastrodon}} used Blizzard as a shield. After the short battle Volkner decides to officially fight Platinum in a Gym battle, because he believes that if Platinum is able to get stronger and defeat him she will be able to beat Jupiter. Empoleon and Electivire then prepare to clash. ==Major events== * [[Candice]], [[Maylene]], and {{adv|Platinum}} arrive at the meeting place to begin their training with [[Volkner]]. * Platinum begins her last Sinnoh Gym battle with Volkner. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Maylene]] * [[Candice]] * [[Volkner]] * [[Cyrus]] (fantasy) * [[Jupiter]] (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{OP|Platinum|Rapidash}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Lopunny}} ({{OP|Platinum|Lopunny}}) * {{p|Riolu}} ([[Maylene]]'s) * {{p|Meditite}} ([[Maylene]]'s) * {{p|Froslass}} ({{OP|Candice|Froslass}}) * {{p|Abomasnow}} ([[Candice]]'s) * {{p|Raichu}} ([[Volkner]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Volkner]]'s) * {{p|Electivire}} ([[Volkner]]'s) * {{p|Sableye}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Gastrodon}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; {{form|Gastrodon|West Sea}}; flashback) * {{p|Tangrowth}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; flashback) ==Trivia== * Platinum reveals that [[Cyrus]] is from [[Sunyshore City]]. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 電擊魔獸|VS Electivire}} (Taiwan)
